sentences: Communities throughout New England have been attempting to regulate short-term rentals since sites like Airbnb took off in the 2010s.

Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there’s an increased urgency in such regulation, particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market.
translations: 自Airbnb等网站在2010年代兴起以来，新英格兰各地的社区一直在尝试监管短期租赁。
如今，由于房价创下历史新高且库存处于历史低位，此类监管的紧迫性有所增加，尤其是对于那些担心开发商会涌入并购买大片住房，以在短期租赁市场上高价转售获利的人来说。

sentences: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market.
The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would’ve made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
translations: 在新罕布什尔州，租金空置率已降至1%以下，住房倡导者担心不受约束的短期租赁将给本已紧张的市场带来进一步压力。
州立法机构最近投票否决了一项法案，该法案原本将使城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规成为非法行为。

sentences: “We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing,” said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast.
Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns, “employers are having a hard time attracting employees, and workers are having a hard time finding a place to live,” Taylor said.
translations: “我们的租赁住房供应正处于危机水平，”大西科斯特劳动力住房联盟执行董事尼克·泰勒表示。
泰勒说，由于新罕布什尔州南部城镇缺乏足够的可负担住房，“雇主难以吸引员工，而工人也难以找到住处。”

sentences: However, short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists, pointed out Ryan Castle, CEO of a local association of realtors.
“A lot of workers are servicing the tourist industry, and the tourism industry is serviced by those people coming in short term,” Castle said, “and so it’s a cyclical effect.”
translations: 然而，当地房地产经纪人协会首席执行官瑞安·卡斯尔指出，短期租赁也为游客提供了住房。
卡斯尔说：“许多工人服务于旅游业，而旅游业又依赖于那些短期来访的人，因此这是一种循环效应。”

sentences: Short-term rentals themselves are not the crux of the issue, said Keren Horn, an expert on affordable housing policy.
“I think individuals being able to rent out their second home is a good thing.
If it’s their vacation home anyway, and it’s just empty, why can’t you make money off it?” Horn said.
Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities—de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations.
“I think the question is, shouldn’t a developer who’s really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?” Horn said.
translations: 可负担住房政策专家凯伦·霍恩表示，短期租赁本身并不是问题的关键。
“我认为个人能够出租自己的第二套住房是件好事。
如果那是他们的度假屋，反正也是空着，为什么不能从中赚钱呢？”霍恩说。
然而，当开发商试图创建大规模短期租赁设施——实际上是酒店——以规避税收和法规时，问题就出现了。
“我认为问题是，一个实际上在建造酒店，却将其伪装成非酒店的开发商，难道不应该像酒店一样被对待、征税和监管吗？”霍恩说。

sentences: At the end of 2018, Governor Charlie Baker of Massachusetts signed a bill to rein in those potential investor-buyers.
The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy.
Boston took things even further, requiring renters to register with the city’s Inspectional Services Department.
translations: 2018年底，马萨诸塞州州长查理·贝克签署了一项法案，以约束那些潜在的投资者买家。
该法案要求每位租赁房东向州政府登记，强制他们购买保险，并在新的州税之上开辟了征收地方税的可能性。
波士顿更进一步，要求租房者向该市的检查服务部门登记。

sentences: Horn said similar registration requirements could benefit struggling cities and towns, but “if we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more.”
translations: 霍恩表示，类似的登记要求可能使陷入困境的城镇受益，但“如果我们想改变住房市场，最主要的是我们必须建造更多住房。”

sentences:
26. Which of the following is true of New England?
A. Its housing supply is at a very low level.
B. Its communities are in need of funding.
C. Its rental vacancy rate is going up slowly.
D. Its home prices are under strict control.
translations:
26. 下列关于新英格兰的说法，哪一项是正确的？
A. 其住房供应处于非常低的水平。
B. 其社区需要资金。
C. 其租金空置率正在缓慢上升。
D. 其房价受到严格控制。

sentences:
27. The bill mentioned in Paragraph 2 was intended to
A. curb short-term rental speculation
B. ensure the supply of cheap housing
C. punish illegal dealings in housing
D. allow a free short-term rental market
translations:
27. 第二段提到的法案旨在
A. 抑制短期租赁投机
B. 确保廉价住房的供应
C. 惩罚住房领域的非法交易
D. 允许自由的短期租赁市场

sentences:
28. Compared with Castle, Taylor is more likely to support
A. further investment in local tourism
B. an increase in affordable housing
C. strict management of real estate agents
D. a favorable policy for short-term workers
translations:

A. 对当地旅游业的进一步投资
B. 增加可负担住房
C. 对房地产经纪人的严格管理
D. 对短期工人的有利政策

sentences:
29. What does Horn emphasize in Paragraph 5?
A. The urgency to upgrade short-term rental facilities.
B. The efficient operation of the local housing market.
C. The necessity to stop developers from evading taxes.
D. The proper procedures for renting out spare houses.
translations:
29. 霍恩在第五段中强调了什么？
A. 升级短期租赁设施的紧迫性。
B. 当地住房市场的有效运作。
C. 阻止开发商逃税的必要性。
D. 出租闲置房屋的适当程序。

sentences:
30. Horn holds that imposing registration requirements is
A. an irrational decision
B. an unfeasible proposal
C. an unnecessary measure
D. an inadequate solution
translations:
30. 霍恩认为，实施登记要求是
A. 一个不合理的决定
B. 一个不可行的提议
C. 一项不必要的措施
D. 一个不充分的解决方案
